name: RunExcelMacro
label: Run Excel Macro
description: Runs a specified VBA macro in the provided Excel workbook.

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: The Excel Workbook object containing the target macro.

fields.name: MacroName
fields.label: Macro Name
fields.description: The name of the VBA macro to execute. For example: 'Module1.MyMacro'

fields.name: MacroReturnValue
fields.label: Macro Return Value
fields.description: Returns the value returned by the macro, if any.
